_comment: CFN parameters this service allows config-deploy.sh (config-only mode) to
change. This is an ALLOWLIST, not a denylist: any parameter that isn't
named here is treated as unsafe-by-default and config-deploy.sh refuses
to proceed if a local .env change would touch it, always falling back to
the value the live stack already has instead. That fail-closed default
is deliberate — forgetting to add a genuinely-safe key here just means
one extra full deploy; forgetting to EXCLUDE a genuinely-unsafe key from
a denylist would silently ship a broken config-only deploy instead.
A parameter belongs here only if changing it can never require a Lambda
code/bundle rebuild — see docs/proposals/config-only-deploy/context.md
category 1 (pure CFN parameter) and category 2 (Lambda runtime env var,
consumed via process.env at runtime, not baked into the bundle).
Deliberately NOT listed, and why:
ServiceName, Env               — identity of the stack itself; changing
either means a different/new stack,
never a same-stack config update.
LambdaPackagesBucketName       — changing this mid-flight points the
Lambda at a bucket that may not hold
the currently-live code artifact.
ApiGatewayRoutesTemplateUrl    — always a fresh content-hashed S3 key
produced by a real deploy uploading
auth-explicit-routes.yaml; config-only
mode never uploads anything, so this
must always carry forward the live
stack's current value.
DatabaseHost/Port/Name/Username/Password
— unused placeholders (org-standard set,
not wired to any resource in
cfn-backend.yaml today); excluded
until they're actually used, at which
point they belong here as pure
runtime creds.
